playlists.name: Multi-Team
playlists.description: 12 players on four teams. Native Lockout Team Slayer pool; guests and parties up to twelve are allowed.

gathering.provenance: Explicit native full-roster-only gathering. At min=max=12, original full-count readiness is immediate and incomplete-count timers cannot start a game. The finite search timeout is native service policy, not a recovered Multi-Team TMS setting.

playlists.provenance: Bungie Dec2005: unranked12/four teams/maxparty12. TU1.5 native 9E1A0/9E010/9E0E0 uses authenticated raw ratings. This explicit native single-map default Team Slayer offering uses weight1 only to select its sole game; it is not a historical rotation. Native gathering uses recovered raw-rank windows; legacy stage/radius fields are unused. Original downloaded Multi-Team weights, full variant buffers and hopper/network configuration remain unavailable.
